name: minimalist-bedroom-aesthetic
image_purpose: Instagram lifestyle portrait and reusable bedroom selfie reference

prompt.project_info: Ultra-realistic modern indoor selfie using the uploaded user image as the primary person reference.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult subject matching the uploaded reference's face, body shape, skin tone, and hairstyle; wearing a black fitted top and black shorts, with a relaxed confident expression and natural skin texture.
prompt.composition_elements: Front-facing eye-level selfie in a cozy minimalist bedroom; large round mirror behind the subject reflects the full back view while the phone is held up, with clean modern interior and no clutter.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft cinematic shadows with purple ambient LED glow, modern intimate lifestyle atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Square 1:1, smartphone front-camera perspective, sharp focus, realistic proportions, subtle makeup, natural skin texture, no over-smoothing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic square modern indoor selfie of the approved adult subject from the attached reference, preserving the referenced face, body shape, skin tone, and hairstyle, wearing a black fitted top and black shorts, front-facing eye-level selfie with a relaxed confident expression in a cozy minimalist bedroom, large round mirror reflecting the full back view and smartphone, soft purple ambient LED lighting, cinematic soft shadows, natural skin texture, sharp focus, realistic lifestyle photography, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent clothing, exposed breasts, exposed genitals, child, minor, unapproved identity change, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, logo
